name: Engineering disasters, machine-first (how it works, then how it failed)

watch_time: mechanism + build-up + failure + aftermath sustains 10-14 min with real depth
click: owns two packaging types: hidden system (x-ray cutaway) and high-stakes failure
satisfaction: clear payoff: viewer finally understands why it failed; no bait needed
chaining: YouTube autocomplete pairs them: 'how does a nuclear reactor work chernobyl'; 'challenger disaster explained'
demand: 'how does a nuclear reactor work' is a top-10 completion of 'how does a'; 'why did the titanic sink' top-10 of 'why did the'; 'engineering disasters' is its own search
freshness: anniversaries and new incidents (air crashes, collapses) give news hooks
gap: 'chernobyl' and 'titanic' completions are dominated by the HBO show and the movie; TV docs (Modern Marvels) own 'engineering disasters'

name: Retirement money explained (Social Security, Medicare, 401k) for 50+

watch_time: older viewers watch long, but many answers are 5-8 min
click: weak visual hooks: no x-ray, no disaster moment
satisfaction: answers a question people actually have
chaining: topics link (claiming age -> spousal -> taxes), less story pull
demand: 'social security' completions: benefits, update today 2026, disability, spousal, at 62, explained
freshness: 'social security update today 2026' shows a news cycle; rules change yearly
